√pṛ2 'pass'
present: [3.] píparti píprati etc. pīpṛhi -- [1.] para -- [2.] párṣi 
aorist: [3.] ápīparat etc. pī́parat pīpárat -- [4.] párṣati etc. párṣat parṣa -- [5.] pāriṣat 
verbal: parṣáṇi 
secondary: causative: pāráyati etc. V.+ pāráyate etc. E.+ pāryate 
derivatives: -páraṇa partṛ́ RV. parṣá? RV. -parṣin? ŚB. parṣáṇi RV. párṣiṣṭha RV. pārá V.+ -pārin AB. pā́raṇa V.+ pāraṇīya E.+ perú V. pápri V. pípru? V. -pāraya RV. pārayitṛ́ B. pārayiṣṇú V.+ 
The aorist stem parṣ has almost won the value of a secondary root.

√pṛ3 'be busy'
present: [5.] pṛṇoti pṛṇvāṇa 
verbal: pṛta E.+ 
secondary: passive: priyate E.+ -- causative: pārayati etc. 
derivatives: -pra? -pāra E.+ 
Only with ā and (especially) vyā; hence in all probability a specialized use of 1 or 2pṛ (1pṛ 'be filled up or occupied', or 2pṛ with vi-ā, 'made to pass to and fro, kept in motion').
